entities.name: Pair Bonding & Early Unions
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: The earliest evidence of formalized pair-bonding appears with settled agriculture. Before farming, human groups likely practiced fluid partnerships. With property, livestock, and inherited land, marriage became the institution that determined who inherited what.
